name: @ai-sidekicks/search-ranking
description: Loads the product's one fuzzy matcher, a WebAssembly module written in Rust, and scores a query as a case-insensitive subsequence of each candidate with the matched positions.

scripts.build: cargo rustc -p sidekicks-search --lib --crate-type cdylib --profile wasm-release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --message-format=json-render-diagnostics | node --experimental-strip-types write-dist.ts && tsc -b --force
